#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class LittleCLoves3II {
public:
    void solve() {
        long long n, m;
        cin >> n >> m;
        
        if (n > m) {
            long long tmp = n;
            n = m;
            m = tmp;
        }
        
        if (n == 1) {
            long long base = (m / 6) * 6;
            long long remainder = m % 6;
            long long extra = max(remainder - 3, 0LL) * 2;
            cout << base + extra << endl;
            return;
        }
        
        if (n == 2) {
            switch ((int)m) {
                case 2:
                    cout << 0 << endl;
                    break;
                case 3:
                    cout << 4 << endl;
                    break;
                case 7:
                    cout << 12 << endl;
                    break;
                default:
                    cout << n * m << endl;
            }
            return;
        }
        
        cout << (n * m / 2) * 2 << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    LittleCLoves3II solver;
    solver.solve();
    
    return 0;
}
